sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page contains available employment information and records related to his involvement in the Eric Roundy encounter.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Joshua M. Jensen began working for the American Fork Police Department on August 9, 2021.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: The records below concern Officer Jensen’s involvement in the Eric Roundy encounter.

Officer Jensen and Officer Bronson T. Kitchen went to Roundy’s home after a woman alleged that Roundy and his wife had harassed her. Officer Cole G. Richardson was waiting by the garage. Ring-camera footage shows the couple declining to answer questions and asking the officers to leave. Jensen and Kitchen continued knocking and ringing the doorbell for approximately 15 minutes and told the couple they needed to come to the door, although the officers did not have a warrant. They left after the couple requested assistance from the Utah County Sheriff’s Office. Disorderly-conduct and obstruction citations were later mailed to the couple.
